description: On-disk scene_resource / entity_resource package fixtures for ECS spawn integration tests (APX-301). Each fixture is a self-contained sk.resource_package document loadable with sk_resource_deserialize_package_json_from_file after registering the built-in asset + component payload types.

fixtures.note: Single entity with transform + camera + light + static tag components
Parent with two children, one child with two grandchildren (nested two levels deep)
Scene with three roots; RootA has a child, RootC has a child with a grandchild
Negative: Components list references a MeshResource (registered repository type, not an ECS component) - spawn must fail
